title: Sagan bumped up against the UFO program

tellings.quote: knowing it's a fact there's my belief he bumped up against the program and was told he needed changes to

plain: The astronomer Carl Sagan may have run into a secret government UFO program and been told he needed to make changes, according to a researcher named Bob Maguire. Maguire says plainly that he does not know this as a fact and offers it as his own belief. If so, it would mean one of the best-known public voices on space was steered by people who knew more.
